headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Stlican Shelf Stirs Again
war_summary: Overnight wires show the Weathered Expanse quickening to eleven changes in two hours and forty in the day around Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk to the latest hour, holdings now three Warden to six Colonial with day losses above ten thousand Colonial and eleven thousand Warden and short rates cooling. Stlican Shelf stirs anew with three changes in two hours and fourteen in the day at Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, latest at 02:34, now four Warden to five Colonial with day losses near twenty-eight hundred Colonial and thirty-one hundred Warden and short rates accelerating. Palantine Berm adds to eight day changes at Leiri Hermanni and The Droll, latest at 00:58, now five Warden to two Colonial. Mooring County holds silent the last two hours after thirty-four day changes around Gravekeeper's Holdfast, Wiccwalk and The Cut, latest at 21:31, still eleven Warden to one Colonial with day losses near eleven thousand a side. Nevish Line, Linn Mercy, Stonecradle and Farranac Coast record no fresh flips, while Callahans Passage posts heavy day losses near eighty-five hundred Colonial and seven thousand Warden without a change.
